split_note: Related new_data parts remain together. Previous experiment calibration becomes development. Final two independent runs held out from all new tuning; historically inspected, not prospective.
gt_definition: Unique class-1 points, robust 2-medians lateral; each center median v and q75 w. Median, q90 and detrended upper line are diagnostics only. Fixed before detector comparisons.
side_convention: L means lower v; R higher v, matching requested equations. For sensor forward -Y, lateral is +X, which viewer calls physical left: L/R naming here is algebraic, not vehicle-side truth.
tuning_frames: At most 80 evenly spaced frames per development run; no validation samples.
tuning_objective: run-equal p95 max(left,right) 2D error; absent supported pair scored as 1m loss, missing GT retained in coverage but not numerical loss
confidence_selection: development 5th percentile among supported primary 8m proposed predictions; target ~95% of supported predictions, not guaranteed final coverage
curvature_source: prior offline class-1 centerline only, evaluation after predictions; never detector input
scene_annotations: platform/switch/tunnel infrastructure are not per-frame semantic labels; do not infer truth from folder names
